title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
summary: Find the largest profit from one purchase followed by one later sale.
algorithmSteps: Track the lowest price seen so far.
At each price, calculate the profit from selling after that lowest price.

examples.explanation: Buying at 1 and selling later at 6 produces the largest profit.

edgeCases: A list with fewer than two prices has no possible profit.
The sale must occur after the purchase.
